title: Spike: stereo ATE regression with the BoW vocabulary (corridor1)
summary: Investigates stereo tracking regression root cause: weak motion-model inlier gating. Proposes fix requiring 30+ inliers for motion-model results with measured improvements.
notes: Spike report documenting a technical investigation with recommended fix. Contains design rationale and implementation guidance, but lacks formal ADR structure (status field, numbered naming, Context/Decision/Consequences sections). Classified as DOC rather than ADR due to format and lack of Status field.
